name: ATPase H+ transporting accessory protein 2

function.text: ATP6AP2 encodes renin receptor (ATPase H(+)-transporting lysosomal accessory protein 2) (ATPase H(+)-transporting lysosomal-interacting protein 2) [Cleaved into: Renin receptor N-terminal fragment; Renin receptor C-terminal fragment]. Annotated molecular activities include signaling receptor activity. It participates in angiotensin maturation and eye pigmentation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to ATP6AP2-related disorder (x-linked); congenital disorder of glycosylation, type IIr (x-linked). Additional curated associations are listed below.
